claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of warnings and errors related to connection issues between Zookeeper nodes, specifically between node 1 and node 3, which is unable to open a channel at the election address /10.10.34.13:3888.
The connection broken error for id 3 and repeated attempts to open a channel indicate a persistent issue with communication between these nodes.
Additionally, there are unrelated error messages from a different date and node (myid=2) showing unexpected exceptions causing shutdowns.
